headline: Federal Energy Minister Sardar Awais Ahmad Khan Leghari invited Turkmenistan to join the CASA-1000 electricity transmission project during a meeting in Islamabad with Turkmenistan's Energy Minister Annageldi Saparov, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Energy ministers of both countries met in Islamabad

caption:
Pakistan invites Turkmenistan to join CASA-1000! ⚡
According to Business Recorder, Federal Minister for Energy (Power Division) Sardar Awais Ahmad Khan Leghari invited Turkmenistan to join the CASA-1000 electricity transmission project during a meeting in Islamabad with Turkmenistan's Minister of Energy Annageldi Saparov. Leghari also proposed making the line two-way, so countries can exchange power when needed. Saparov reaffirmed Turkmenistan's commitment to the TAP power project, which he said could serve over 300 million people.
